naming_punctuation.title: Names contain punctuation a keyboard does not type

init.title: Straighten names typed on a phone
init.description:
A phone substitutes typographic punctuation as you type, so `Isabel’s Lamp` and `Isabel's Lamp` are different strings. Home Assistant matches areas by name and turns names into entity IDs, so one curled apostrophe can create a **duplicate area with no floor** and a second spelling of the same entity ID.

Found:

{changes}

Choose **Names and areas** for the safe half: display names and duplicate-area merges, which nothing can reference. Choose **Names, areas and entity IDs** to also rewrite the entity IDs the old spelling created.

everything.title: Also rewrite {entities} entity ID(s)?
